Complete To Dream a Thousand Deaths and notes

transcriptions.text: Spirits May Yet Dream. Fast; ANY Spirit. 2 Moon 2 Air: Turn any face-down Fear Card face-up. (It’s earned/resolved normally, but players can see what’s coming.) 3 Moon: Target Spirit gains an Element they have at least 1 of.

To Dream a Thousand Deaths. Your Powers never cause Damage, nor can they Destroy anything other than your own Presence. When a Power of yours would Destroy (or deal enough Damage to Destroy) Explorer/Town/City, generate 0/2/5 Fear instead. The Power Pushes all Explorers/Towns it would Destroy. Notes: A single Power cannot Destroy a given Invader more than once. Powers which cause Damage via Dahan are affected just like all others. All effects other than Damage/Destroy work as usual.

Growth (Pick One): Reclaim Cards and Gain Power Card; Reclaim One and Add a Presence Range 0; Gain Power Card and Add a Presence Range 1; Add a Presence Range 4 to Land with Dahan or Invaders and Gain 2 Energy.
Night Terrors. Fast; Range 0; target land INVADERS. 1 Moon 1 Air: 1 Fear. 2 Moon 1 Air 1 Animal: +1 Fear. 3 Moon 2 Air 1 Animal: +1 Fear.

observations: Complete native back inspected; title and same artwork corroborate the front. Printed setup places 2 Presence in highest-numbered Sands on starting board. High complexity and a descriptive play-style paragraph accompany it.

transcriptions.text: Poisoned Land. Cost 3; Slow; Range 1; target ANY. Printed Elements: Earth, Plant, Animal. 1 Fear. 7 Damage. Add 1 Blight and destroy all Dahan. Threshold 3 Earth 2 Plant 2 Animal: For each Blight then present, +1 Fear and +4 Damage.

observations: Whole original printed face inspected, including all corners. Repeat is another use, not a single simultaneous two-Blight addition. With sufficient Energy it can Repeat Poisoned Land for the separate-instructions branch of Q116.

transcriptions.text: Powerstorm. Cost 3; Fast; target ANY Spirit. Printed Elements: Sun, Fire, Air. Target Spirit gains 3 Energy. Once this turn, target may Repeat a Power Card by paying its cost again. Threshold 2 Sun 2 Fire 3 Air: Target may Repeat up to 2 more Power Cards by paying their costs.
